tasks.title: Remove SessionManager and agent_session_message dead code
tasks.description: Delete the unused SessionManager class (session.ts), AgentSessionMessageRepo, agent_session_message table, and all references. Remove SessionManager from server/index.ts instantiation, remove the _agentSessionMessageRepo parameter from AgentRunnerService constructor, remove exports from agent-runtime/index.ts and db/index.ts, remove the agentSessionMessageRepo field/getter from StateManager, and add a migration to DROP TABLE agent_session_message.
acceptanceCriteria: No file imports or references SessionManager or AgentSessionMessageRepo
AgentRunnerService constructor no longer takes _agentSessionMessageRepo parameter
tasks.notes: Pure deletion task. The AgentSessionMessageRepo.insert() has zero callers in the codebase. The SessionManager manages in-memory sessions unconnected to real ACP sessions.

tasks.title: Merge AcpSessionOptions and AcpConnectionOptions into unified type
tasks.description: Replace the two near-identical option interfaces (AcpSessionOptions with 19 fields, AcpConnectionOptions with 15 fields, 14 shared) with a single AgentSessionOptions type. Add `task?: string` (for withSession), `signal?: AbortSignal` (from AcpConnectionOptions), `observers?: SessionObserver[]` (new). Keep `onSessionUpdate` for backward compatibility during migration. Update all 11 consumer files to use the new type name. Keep `AcpSessionResult` and `AcpConnection` interfaces unchanged for now.
acceptanceCriteria: Single AgentSessionOptions type exported from agent-runtime
All 11 consumer files compile with the new type
tasks.notes: This is a type-level refactor only. No behavior change. The SessionObserver interface can be a placeholder (just the interface definition) at this stage — it gets implemented in T-004.

tasks.title: Extract AcpProcess from acp-session.ts
tasks.description: Extract subprocess spawn/kill/lifecycle logic from both runAcpSession and createAcpConnection into a new acp-process.ts module. AcpProcess handles: spawn with env sanitization (filter OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD/USERNAME), SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation with 5s delay, stdin/stdout stream lifecycle, error/exit event handling, and provide WritableStream/ReadableStream for ndJsonStream. The existing functions delegate to AcpProcess but keep their current signatures and behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: AcpProcess handles spawn, kill (SIGTERM→SIGKILL), stdin/stdout lifecycle, error/exit events
runAcpSession and createAcpConnection both use AcpProcess internally
No behavior change — all existing tests pass
tasks.notes: This is structural extraction only. The two functions still exist but delegate process management to AcpProcess. No consumer-facing API change.

tasks.title: Implement SessionObserver interface and WorkflowSessionObserver
tasks.description: Define the SessionObserver interface with onSessionStart, onTextChunk, onToolCall, onSessionEvent, onStateChange, and onRawNotification (for PlanStageRunner's plan_session_update forwarding). Implement WorkflowSessionObserver that encapsulates all current inline side-effects: EventBus emission (coder_text_chunk, coder_tool_call, coder_session_started, coder_session_completed), sessionStreamLogRepo.insert, workflowLogRepo.insert, coderSessionRepo.insert/updateStatus. Wire WorkflowSessionObserver into runAcpSession and createAcpConnection so they dispatch events through observers instead of inline code.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionObserver interface exported from agent-runtime with typed methods
WorkflowSessionObserver implements all observer methods matching current inline behavior
runAcpSession and createAcpConnection no longer directly call eventBus.emit, sessionStreamLogRepo.insert, workflowLogRepo.insert, or coderSessionRepo.insert/updateStatus
SSE events (coder_text_chunk, coder_tool_call, coder_session_started) still emitted with identical payloads
coder_session rows still created and status updated on completion/failure
session_stream_log rows still written for all SESSION_STREAM_EVENT_TYPES
PlanStageRunner's onSessionUpdate → plan_session_update forwarding works via onRawNotification
tasks.notes: This is the critical decoupling step. The observer pattern must produce identical side-effects to current inline code. Test by verifying SSE event payloads are unchanged and coder_session rows have correct status transitions.

tasks.title: Implement AgentSession class replacing runAcpSession and createAcpConnection
tasks.description: Create the AgentSession class with static create() factory, execute(prompt), cancel(), close(), and state getter. Implement withSession(options, fn) that auto-manages create→execute→close in a try/finally. AgentSession composes AcpProcess + the ACP protocol logic (initialize, newSession, prompt, cancel, setSessionConfigOption) and dispatches all events through SessionObserver[]. Update all 11 consumer files: skill-service, explore-acp-service, code-compiles-check, build-test-check, ralph-executor → use withSession; conflict-resolution, server/index.ts → use AgentSession.create with single execute+close; plan-stage-runner, check-stage-runner → use AgentSession.create with multi-execute loop. Delete runAcpSession and createAcpConnection functions. Delete the old acp-session.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentSession.create() and withSession() are the only public session APIs
runAcpSession and createAcpConnection no longer exist
All 11 consumer files use new API and compile
ralph-executor's setAcpSessionRunner/resetAcpSessionRunner DI pattern works with new API
PlanStageRunner multi-prompt loop works with AgentSession.create + multiple execute() calls
SSE events (coder_text_chunk, coder_tool_call, coder_session_started) still emitted identically
tasks.notes: This is the largest task. The AgentSession class should be under 300 lines. The ACP protocol logic (ClientSideConnection, ndJsonStream, initialize/newSession/prompt/cancel) can stay inline in AgentSession or be extracted to acp-protocol.ts per design D2 — agent decides.

tasks.title: Update tests to use new AgentSession API
tasks.description: Update all 6 test files that reference runAcpSession, createAcpConnection, or AcpConnection to use withSession, AgentSession.create, and AgentSession class. Tests: ralph-executor.test.ts, skill-service.test.ts, pipeline-checkpoint.test.ts, acp-hang-recovery.test.ts, acp-connection.test.ts, acp-session-taskid.test.ts. Ensure all mock patterns work with the new API shape.
acceptanceCriteria: No test file imports runAcpSession or createAcpConnection
All test mocks/stubs use withSession or AgentSession.create
npm test passes with all tests green

tasks.title: Implement SessionStateMachine with coder_session as source of truth
tasks.description: Define SessionState type and VALID_TRANSITIONS map. Implement SessionStateMachine.transition() that validates transitions and writes to coder_session table via CoderSessionRepo.updateStatus(). Integrate state machine into AgentSession so all state changes go through transition(). Add process_pid INTEGER column to coder_session via migration; AgentSession.create() writes proc.pid. Refactor AgentRunnerService to query coder_session for running sessions instead of relying on in-memory runningSlots Map as primary source.
acceptanceCriteria: Every state change writes to coder_session.status in DB
Migration adds process_pid column (nullable) to coder_session
tasks.notes: The runningSlots Map in AgentRunnerService can remain as a performance cache, but the DB becomes the authoritative source. Orphan detection should work from DB queries alone.
